description.en: Petrolacosaurus kansensis inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m technical asset length, not biological measurement. Benton1985 printed p110 PDF14 Fig2 A whole skeleton and B-E skull after Reisz1981 Garnett composite. No single accession named in figure; unknown and not invented. Wehrbein2017 Fig10 Tamura life art is soft-tissue comparator only; no copying of colors, image or mesh. Long neck, slender trunk, near-equal long limbs and complete tail preserved. Skin, soft tissue depth, digit lengths and pose artistic. KU shell and BHL403 not retried
